architecture: Native Qt widgets and C++ hosts; custom-scheme WebView2 renders the plugin HTML inside a small compatibility iframe wrapper. The product application shell and JavaScript worker are native Qt/C++ plus statically linked QuickJS, without Electron or Node.

contract.apps: API.openApp(appId,{pluginId?,title?,target:tab,setActive?}) resolves {tabId}. Opening the active same app refreshes/reuses it. closeApp closes the active app. sendMessage targets only that agent's active matching app/plugin. onMessage returns unsubscribe and persists across tool calls.
contract.cdp: API.onCDPEvent(tabId,event,callback) returns unsubscribe; listeners remain alive after the setup IIFE returns. Real CDP events can update globalThis and invoke API.sendMessage while no tool is running. Tab teardown ends its CDP subscriptions.
contract.events: Native-issued context generation UUIDs bind all listeners and background RPCs. Reset/cancel invalidates the generation and removes subscriptions, broker calls, apps and credential handles before late replies can settle new work. Other agents remain active. Ordinary callback exceptions are logged; infinite idle callbacks reset the affected context.
contract.app_resources: app://plugins/<plugin>/<app>/... and app://agents/<agent>/<app>/... use one host-authorized root per view, GET/HEAD only. Exact identity and decoded path validation reject traversal, foreign roots, Windows device/ADS syntax, encoded separators and oversized/missing assets. Windows opens and validates the final canonical file handle, then reads that same handle to avoid junction/path races.
contract.messages: The compatibility wrapper accepts only its exact iframe window and expected app origin. The native receiver checks WebView2-provided Source equals its nonce-scoped ade-app://preview URL, plus the per-navigation nonce and channel. Direct iframe chrome.webview messages cannot impersonate the parent. Delivery uses JSON, never interpolated user code.
contract.profiles: Separate WebView2 profile paths per agent/plugin/app protect cookies and local storage despite shared app://plugins scheme origin. Host-only adeOwnerAgentId protects CDP and tab discovery; regular browser tabs remain shared.
contract.resource_policy: Mini-app CSP permits local inline/self scripts and styles, local/data/blob images and local fonts, with same-origin connect only. Child frames, forms, top-level external navigation and native browser permissions/downloads are blocked. This is narrower than arbitrary upstream HTML/network behavior and is documented as a compatibility gap.

proof.scope: Traversal, exact identities, HEAD/MIME/size limits and an actual NTFS junction pointing outside the root.
Real custom scheme iframe message queue/ACK, profile-localStorage isolation, foreign app/file requests, native-source spoof rejection, native tab refresh/close/cancel/destruction.

Persistent idle events, background sends, unsubscribe, throw/infinite loop behavior, bounded queue, agent/generation isolation, synchronous cancellation and artifact junction/signal-order regressions. Idle attachments preserve writes and associate metadata only with an active same-agent/context tool.

Pinned Figma selection recipe using real local HTTP fixture, WebView2 CDP binding events, idle QuickJS callback, actual packaged iframe DOM/ACK and malicious custom-data literal-text regression. Independent negative foreign-agent tab/CDP checks.
Existing network/credential behavior preserved after persistent event/context changes.
Existing CDP/log/permissions/data-clear/download behavior preserved after custom scheme additions.

figma.exact_path: Local figma.currentPage.selection mutation -> Runtime.bindingCalled -> API.onCDPEvent idle callback -> API.sendMessage -> packaged Figma badge DOM -> iframe ACK -> next sandbox IIFE. Unsubscribe and close stop later selection updates.
figma.packaged_fix: Custom data is rendered with createElement/pre.textContent/replaceChildren instead of innerHTML. Fixture confirms text is literal with no created image or executed injected variable.
figma.inspection: Packaged app runs as an out-of-process iframe. Test attaches to its CDP target with Target.attachToTarget and Target.sendMessageToTarget; page-level executionContextId is not a valid way to inspect that frame.
figma.service_limit: No actual Figma account/service was accessed. The real Figma web page exposing the recipe's figma.currentPage API is not established by this controlled fixture.
figma.package_status: Activated in PluginCatalog and qrc after the recipe fixture passed; materialized nested resource extraction and hashes verified by the separate plugin suite.

concrete_fixes: Custom scheme registration initially used a NuGet SDK version for TargetCompatibleBrowserVersion and WebView2 environment creation failed 0x80070002; corrected to the runtime product version.
Source-only app messaging checks were insufficient for shared browser registry access; agent-scoped tab discovery and CDP dispatch now enforce native owner identity.
Old-generation late event/RPC delivery cannot settle a replacement agent context.
Artifact signals are emitted before RPC success so root attachment adoption precedes tool result completion.
known_gaps: Writable apps/ authoring is now covered by audit/app-authoring-native.json; full Node filesystem APIs and additional mounts remain incomplete.
Arbitrary remote scripts/resources and embedded frames are intentionally outside current mini-app CSP; supplied Figma app uses local assets.
Full upstream Node/Web API compatibility and HTTPS importModule remain incomplete.

Async continuation ownership for event callbacks overlapping active calls is not a complete AsyncLocalStorage equivalent; tested recipe uses synchronous event callback with a fire-and-forget app send.
Profile data for apps is separated from ordinary browser clearing; any app-specific data management UI is a separate feature.
